related_questions.question: Can I get Tamiflu without going to the doctor?

text_blocks.snippet: No, Tamiflu (oseltamivir) is a prescription medication and cannot be purchased over the counter. You need a prescription from a healthcare provider to obtain it. It is most effective when taken within 48 hours of symptom onset, so it's important to see a doctor quickly if you think you have the flu, according to GoodRx.
snippet_highlighted_words: No, Tamiflu (oseltamivir) is a prescription medication and cannot be purchased over the counter

list.title: Effectiveness:
list.snippet: Tamiflu works best when started early, within the first 48 hours of symptoms. A doctor can assess your symptoms and determine if Tamiflu is the right treatment for you.

list.title: Safety:
list.snippet: Tamiflu can have side effects, and a doctor can assess your individual risk factors and ensure it's safe for you to take, says the CDC.

list.title: Proper Use:
list.snippet: A doctor can provide guidance on dosage and duration of treatment, ensuring you are using Tamiflu correctly, according to Tamiflu.com.

text_blocks.snippet: While Tamiflu requires a prescription, there are over-the-counter medications that can help manage flu symptoms, such as pain relievers and fever reducers (like acetaminophen) and decongestants (like pseudoephedrine), according to GoodRx.

It's important to see a doctor if you have flu symptoms, especially if you are at high risk for flu complications (e.g., older adults, people with chronic conditions). If you're very sick or worried about your illness, seek medical care promptly, says the CDC.
